title: Grilled Pide with Pear Compote
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dessert using Turkish pide and pear, perfect for a gluten-free diet.
instructions: Brush the pide with a little water and grill for 2-3 minutes on each side, until lightly toasted.
In a pan, heat the yummy spice over low heat for 1 minute.
Add the pear wedges to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until caramelized.
Serve the grilled pide with the pear compote.
